newsitem.title: USA: Wall St stocks lifted at open on payrolls relief.
newsitem.headline: Wall St stocks lifted at open on payrolls relief.

text.p: U.S. stocks rallied at the open on Friday after a doomsday scenario failed to emerge from the August payrolls and wage report.
The Dow industrials stood nine points at 5,616 after climbing as many as 22 points in early trade. The Nasdaq Composite gained five points to 1,131 and the S&P 500 index rose one point to 651.
"There was a great sigh of relief at the open," said Alan Ackerman, market strategist at Fahnestock & Co. "People came to the office today expecting the worst."
